responsibilities.value: Launched the 0x API v2 and implemented support processes around it, delivering a 99.82% uptime while ensuring robust architecture.
Reformed hiring process to eliminate bottlenecks and reduce time-to-hire by 30%; demonstrated leadership by coaching managers and VPs on recruiting and retaining a globally remote team.
Coached product leaders through roadmap exercises and instituted a prioritization framework resulting in a 100% delivery rate of high priority items on or ahead of schedule.
Introduced a security response process and SLA for vulnerable dependencies which reduced API wide attack surface by more than 90% for critical and high priority issues without delaying deliverables.
